intro: Tourism and shipping are the twin engines of the Greek economy, which is still recovering from a severe debt crisis.

chapters.title: Tourism and shipping
text: Tens of millions of tourists visit each year for islands, beaches and ancient sites. Greek shipowners control the largest merchant fleet in the world, carrying goods across every ocean.

chapters.title: Olives and the crisis
text: Greece is a major producer of olive oil, olives, feta cheese and yoghurt. After 2009 Greece could not pay its debts, needed three international bailouts and endured years of cuts and unemployment; the economy has been growing again since. Greece uses the euro.
